TET2 x ISR translatomic transfer: research report (public)

PUBLIC-DATA RUN. Basal TET2 contrasts and ISR translation signatures are observed in the cited GEO series. Everything that combines them is a transfer-based prediction. No public dataset measures translation in TET2-deficient cells under ISR, so the genotype x ISR translation interaction (I_TE) is not estimated.

Regenerate with make public. Methods: docs/methods.md. Limits: docs/assumptions_and_limits.md. Inputs and checksums: provenance.json in the run directory.

2. Identifiability: the 2x2 example

Gene A doubles in mRNA with TET2 loss; ISR doubles its TE in both genotypes. Linear output differs (I_S_linear = 10 units) while I_TE = 0 and gene-level log I_S = 0. The two-gene pathway shows a non-zero aggregate log interaction purely because the abundance weights differ.

unit dTE_WT dTE_TET2 I_TE dS_linear_WT dS_linear_TET2 I_S_linear I_S_log2
A 1.0000 1.0 0.0000 10.0 20.0 10.0 -0.0000
B -1.0000 -1.0 0.0000 -20.0 -20.0 0.0 0.0000
pathway{A,B} -0.3219 0.0 0.3219 -10.0 0.0 10.0 0.3219

6. Genotype x ISR predictions

M2/M3 genotype prediction NOT RUN: 3 ISR-engaged contexts from 3 studies; the state-dependent model has 3 state covariates and needs >= 6 contexts (config: min_contexts_for_state_model). Model-based I_TE is not identifiable from these data.

No direct genotype x ISR translatome is available: nothing here validates a genotype-specific translation effect.
